text:
anna: FYI CloudFlex just pinged us — their marketplace invoice shows ~1.2M gpu-minutes but our billing records show ~950k gpu-seconds. they flagged it as a billing gap, asking for root cause. can someone triage?

mike: timeline? did they send raw usage files or rely on marketplace webhooks?

anna: they rely on Marketplace webhooks + snapshot exports. reported numbers are the monthly aggregate they see in their vendor portal. they provided a sample webhook we asked for.

julia: pasting the sample payload they sent (sanitized):

```
{
  "customer_id": "cf-1234",
  "resource_sku": "CF-GPU-XL",
  "usage_amount": 20000,
  "usage_unit": "minutes",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T02:12:00Z",
  "external_id": "cf-event-9876"
}
```

julia: our parser expects gpu_seconds (unit: "seconds") and applies no minutes->seconds conversion. i just grep'd the ingestion code path and the unit switch lives in marketplace-transformer but only for 'hours'->seconds. minutes wasn't handled.

simon: marketplace-bot delivery logs show the webhook was received intact and the event mapped to product CF-GPU-XL. sample log snippet: `POST /v1/marketplace/webhook 200 2026-03-18T02:12:01Z payload_id=cf-event-9876`. no errors.

mike: that would explain the delta: 20k minutes -> 1.2M seconds. our aggregator treated 20k as seconds, so our total became much smaller. good catch.

anna: cloudflex says their portal sums minutes and expects the marketplace to bill minutes. is our canonical unit seconds? what's the contract?

julia: internally we canonicalize to seconds for historical reasons, but marketplace contracts are per-minute for some partners. mapping should be per-partner SKU metadata (we have a per-sku unit mapping table). looks like CF-GPU-XL entry was misconfigured to 'seconds' instead of 'minutes' during onboarding.

mike: immediate plan: 1) update SKU metadata (billing-config) to mark CF-GPU-XL as minutes 2) re-run aggregation for affected month converting minutes->seconds to align historical totals 3) produce a reconciliation report and partner-facing note with proposed credit/backfill numbers.

simon: re-aggregation impact: estimated rows ~120k events for March for that SKU. can run reprocess job on analytics cluster during off-peak. i'll prep a job. PR to infra tags: backfill-197250. ETA ~4h for dry-run, 8h for full run.

julia: I'll open a quick patch to marketplace-transformer to add explicit minutes->seconds conversion and a unit-assert test. also update the SKU mapping UI defaults so new onboardings don't miss it.

mike: i'll draft the partner note. suggested wording: short expl of unit mismatch, our corrective steps, and a proposed credit equal to reclaimed delta if they were overcharged. ping @legal if we need wording tweaks.

anna: thanks. action items:
- simon: run dry-run backfill job and post results (rows processed, delta tokens/sec and aggregate change) — assigned
- julia: patch + unit tests + update sku mapping entry — assigned
- mike: draft partner message & reconciliation numbers after dry-run — assigned

marketplace-bot: Webhook cf-event-9876 processed by transformer v3.4.1 at 2026-03-18T02:12:01Z (no transform errors).

anna: quick note: let's not promise credits until we confirm dry-run numbers. aim to update CloudFlex by EOD PST. please drop updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

mike: acked, will wait for simon then send draft.

simon: starting dry-run now, will post logs & summary when complete.

julia: patch is up for review (link: https://git.redwood/marketplace/transformer/pulls/502) — includes unit conversion and a migration to validate units on import.

anna: great. thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for partner comms.

mike: once we have numbers i'll also include a reconciliation CSV with columns: external_id, partner_amount, partner_unit, canonical_seconds, our_previous_seconds, delta_seconds, action (credit/backfill/none). that should make approvals easier.

simon: dry-run finished. results: processed 121,342 events, summed partner_minutes=1,200,000 -> canonical_seconds=72,000,000. previous_canonical_seconds_in_db=3,600,000. net_delta_seconds=68,400,000 (which explains the 1.2M vs 950k confusion once units normalized). attaching dry-run stats link: https://analytics.redwood/jobs/197250-dryrun-502

julia: confirmed patch tests pass. i'll merge after one more review.

mike: drafting partner note now with numbers. will post here before sending.

anna: excellent. after partner ack we'll schedule a production reprocess window and confirm any customer credits. closing loop once partner responds. :white_check_mark:
